A.
MINUTES OF PREVIOUS CITY COUNCIL AND SUCCESSOR AGENCY MEETINGS
A-1
READ AND APPROVE THE MINUTES OF THE CITY COUNCIL AND SUCCESSOR AGENCY MEETING OF JANUARY 13, 2015
It is recommended that the City Council and Successor Agency waive the reading and approve the Minutes of the City Council and Successor Agency meeting of January 13, 2015.
A-1 Minutes 1-13-15 CC-SA
B.
PUBLIC HEARINGS BEFORE THE CITY COUNCIL - None
C.
UNFINISHED BUSINESS OF THE CITY COUNCIL
C-1
QUARTERLY UPDATE AND DISCUSSION REGARDING THE CITY'S CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECTS - FISCAL YEAR 2014-15 - 2ND QUARTER
It is recommended that the City Council receive and file the update.
C-1 CIP Quarterly Update
C-2
QUARTERLY UPDATE AND DISCUSSION REGARDING THE CITY'S SPECIAL EVENTS
It is recommended that the City Council receive and file the update.
C-2 Special Events Quarterly Update
D.
CITY COUNCIL AND SUCCESSOR AGENCY CONSENT CALENDAR
All matters listed under Consent Calendar are considered to be routine in nature and may be enacted by one motion approving the recommendation listed on the Agenda. One or more items may be removed from the Consent Calendar so that said item(s) may be discussed and considered individually by the City Council, if a motion to remove the item(s) is approved by an affirmative vote of a majority of the members of the City Council. Those specific item(s) will be considered as the first item under New Business.
D-1
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION APPROVING WARRANT REGISTER NO. 1378
It is recommended that the City Council adopt Resolution No. 15-5185 approving Warrant Register No. 1378.
D-1 Warrant Register 1378
D-2
CONSIDERATION OF A SECOND AMENDMENT TO AGREEMENT NO. 12-101 WITH CLIENTFIRST CONSULTING GROUP, LLC TO PROVIDE INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY MANAGEMENT AND SUPPORT SERVICES TO THE CITY, IN AN AMOUNT NOT TO EXCEED $54,648.00 PER YEAR
It is recommended that the City Council approve the Second Amendment to Agreement No. 12-101 with ClientFirst Consulting Group, LLC.
D-2 IT Staff Report - IT Management and Support Services
D-2 IT Attachment A - Second Amendment
D-2 IT Attachment B - Agreement No. 12-1101 ClientFirst
D-2 IT Attachment C - Agreement No. 12-1101-01 ClientFirst - signed
D-3
CONSIDERATION OF CHANGE ORDERS IN THE AMOUNT OF $102,800.00 FOR THE LOCAL STREET IMPROVEMENTS/SANTO ORO STORM DRAIN IMPROVEMENT PROJECT AND AN ALLOCATION OF $45,000.00 IN MEASURE R FUNDS TO THE PROJECT
It is recommended that the City Council: 1) Approve change orders in the amount of $102,800.00; and 2) Authorize the appropriation of $45,000.00 from available Measure R fund balance.
D-3 Staff Report - Santo Oro Project - Increase for Contingency
D-4
SECOND READING OF ORDINANCE NO. 15-935 REPEALING TITLE 10 (ZONING) OF THE LA PUENTE MUNICIPAL CODE IN ITS ENTIRETY (INCLUDING THE ZONING MAP), WITH THE EXCEPTION OF CHAPTER 10.62 (ADULT BUSINESSES), ADOPTING A REVISED TITLE 10 (ZONING) AND ZONING MAP, AND AN ADDENDUM REGARDING SAME
It is recommended that the City Council adopt Ordinance No.15-935 repealing Title 10 (Zoning) of the La Puente Municipal Code in its entirety (including the Zoning Map), with the exception of Chapter 10.62 (Adult Businesses), adopt a revised Title 10 (Zoning), and Land Use Policy Map and an Addendum to the General Plan EIR regarding same.
D-4 Zoning Code Staff Report - Second Reading
D-4 Zoning Code Attachment A Resolution No. 14-1470
D-4 Zoning Code Attachment B Ordinance 935
D-4 Zoning Code Attachment C - Matrix of Changes
D-4 Zoning Code Attachment D - Addendum to EIR
D-5
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION ADOPTING CITY COUNCIL POLICY CC-10.1, BUDGET AND FISCAL POLICIES
It is recommended that the City Council adopt Resolution No. 15-5186 approving City Council Policy CC-10.1, Budget and Fiscal Policies.
D-5 Budget Policy Staff Report
D-5 Budget Policy Resolution
E.
NEW BUSINESS TO BE CONSIDERED BY THE CITY COUNCIL
E-1
PLANNING COMMISSION APPOINTMENT DUE TO AN UNSCHEDULED VACANCY
It is recommended that Councilmember Munoz appoint a Planning Commissioner to fill the current vacancy.
E-1 Planning Commission Vacancy Staff Report

ADJOURNMENT
AVAILABILITY
Any writings or documents provided to a majority of the City Council/Successor Agency regarding any item on this agenda will be made available for public inspection during normal business hours at City Hall located at 15900 E. Main Street, the La Puente Community Center located at 501 North Glendora and the Los Angeles County Library located at 15920 E. Central. In addition, such writings and documents will be posted on the City's website at http://www.lapuente.org.
AMERICANS WITH DISABILITIES
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate in a City meeting or other services offered by the City, please contact the City Clerk's Office at (626) 855-1500. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide accessibility to the meeting or service.
MEETING TIMES
Meetings of the City Council shall be adjourned no later than 10:30 p.m., unless a motion to supersede the 10:30 time limit to consider some or all of the remaining items listed on the Agenda, or to consider items which have been added to the Agenda in accordance with the provisions of the Ralph M. Brown Act, Government Code Section 54950, et seq., is approved by a majority of the members of the City Council. (Ordinance No. 95-727).
CERTIFICATION
